data.job_description:
Experimentation and funnel analytics for hotel booking flows. You will own metrics, build dashboards and run deep dives with product and business teams.

Requirements
• 2-4 years of experience in analytics
• Strong SQL and Python (Pandas)
• Power BI or Tableau dashboards
• A/B testing and statistics
• Stakeholder management and data storytelling

Nice to have
• BigQuery or Snowflake
• dbt
